answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, while detected equivocation is clustered by evidence of shared control: when k identities coordinate, penalties scale as O(k^2), rapidly making correlated misbehavior uneconomic. A detected sybil swarm also incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation reducing recoverable stake. Attestation pulse, nectar, and whisper channels can expose coordination without weakening proof.
